definitions.explanation: The traditional craft of sewing Japanese clothing such as kimono, yukata, and other traditional garments. Uses techniques distinct from Western dressmaking.

examples.japanese: {和裁|わさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}っている→習う：00479_narau⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和裁|わさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother has Japanese sewing skills.

examples.japanese: {和裁|わさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}して→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧おり、⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{継承|けいしょう}→継承：13841_keishou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The number of Japanese sewing artisans is declining year by year, and passing on the techniques has become a challenge.

notes:
A compound of {和|わ} (Japanese) and {裁|さい} (cutting/sewing). Contrasted with ⟦{洋裁|ようさい}→洋裁：20802_yousai⟧ (Western-style dressmaking). Japanese sewing uses different techniques — kimono are sewn entirely by hand with straight seams, and the fabric can be taken apart and resewn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和裁|わさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: to learn Japanese sewing
- {和裁|わさい}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧: Japanese sewing class
- {和裁|わさい}⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧: certified Japanese sewing professional
- {和裁|わさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: Japanese sewing techniques

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{洋裁|ようさい}→洋裁：20802_yousai⟧: Western-style dressmaking — cutting and sewing Western clothing
- ⟦{裁縫|さいほう}→裁縫：04163_saihou⟧: sewing — general term for all sewing
- ⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立てる：09525_shitateru⟧: tailoring — making garments to order
